en-US.longDescription:
Deeper than pockets - PocketStation emulator.

Extract the kernel ROM and flash ROM images from the device, rename them to ‘KROM’ and ‘FROM’ respectively, place them in the same folder as PK201.EXE, and then run the program.
en-US.name: PK201
